concerns.text: Task T009 (Create JSON schemas for TeacherRoutingDataset, InferenceResult, DecisionTreeMetadata) is marked as incomplete [ ]. This task is a foundational prerequisite for US2 (T024 validates against DecisionTreeMetadata.json) and US3 (T028/T030 rely on InferenceResult structure). Without this task being executable, the plan cannot satisfy FR-001 (dataset generation) or FR-004/FR-005 (inference/metrics) as the contracts required for validation are missing.

Task T013b (Detect undefined routing paths, exclude samples, log to exclusion_log.json) is marked as incomplete [ ]. This directly implements the Edge Case handling in spec.md ('The pipeline must log the event and exclude the sample...') and is a prerequisite for T014 and T016b. Without this, the dataset may contain invalid labels, violating FR-001's requirement for 'valid expert identifiers'.

Task T014 (Extract fields and stream to teacher_routing_dataset.parquet) is marked as incomplete [ ]. This is the core deliverable for FR-001 and US1. Without this task, no dataset exists for US2 (T020) or US3 (T028), making the entire downstream plan unexecutable.

Task T016b (Validate dataset contains samples from both ImageNet-1K and LAION-400M) is marked as incomplete [ ]. This validates the dual-source requirement in FR-001 and US1. Without this, the spec's requirement to sample from 'both' sources is not enforced.

Task T018 (Unit test for Decision Tree training parameters) is marked as incomplete [ ]. While tests are optional per the header, the spec's 'Independent Test' for US2 requires verifying 'DecisionTreeClassifier instantiation with specific depths'. If T018 is intended to cover this, its absence leaves the US2 test criteria unmet.

Task T030 (Compute FID/CLIP on entire dataset) is marked as incomplete [ ]. This is the primary implementation for FR-005 and SC-002. Without this, the project cannot measure image quality degradation or perform the statistical tests in T030a, failing FR-006.

Task T034 (Documentation updates) is marked as incomplete [ ]. While often a polish item, the plan's 'Project Structure' and 'Quickstart' sections imply documentation is a deliverable. If the 'quickstart.md' validation (T038) depends on this, the pipeline cannot be verified end-to-end.

Task T035b (Remove dead code) is marked as incomplete [ ]. While a polish item, the Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) imply clean, maintainable code. If 'dead code' includes unused imports that cause runtime errors in the CI environment (as hinted in T035c), this could block execution.

Task T035c (Optimize imports to remove circular dependencies) is marked as incomplete [ ]. Circular dependencies can cause import errors that prevent the pipeline from running, violating the Constitution's requirement that 'Every notebook or script under code/ is runnable end-to-end'.

Task T036a (Performance optimization for data streaming) is marked as incomplete [ ]. The spec's SC-005 and Assumptions explicitly mention memory constraints (≤7 GB RAM). Without this optimization, the pipeline may crash on large datasets, violating the computational feasibility requirement.

Task T036b (Performance optimization for batch processing) is marked as incomplete [ ]. Similar to T036a, the 6-hour runtime constraint (SC-005) may be violated without batch processing optimizations, especially for the full dataset evaluation in T030.

Task T037 (Additional unit tests for edge cases) is marked as incomplete [ ]. The spec's 'Edge Cases' section explicitly requires handling for 'undefined expert routing path' and 'memory exhaustion'. T037 is the only task explicitly addressing these edge cases in the test suite. Without it, the spec's edge case handling is not verified.

Task T038 (Run quickstart.md validation) is marked as incomplete [ ]. This is the final verification step for the entire pipeline. Without it, the 'Independent Test' criteria for all user stories cannot be confirmed as met in an end-to-end manner.

Task T016c is marked as complete [X] but the description states it is 'redundant with T013b' and 'kept for traceability'. This creates confusion in the task list. While not a missing task, the presence of a redundant, completed task alongside an incomplete primary task (T013b) suggests a potential misalignment in the task status tracking.
